+import base64
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+from typing import Any, Dict, List
+
+import requests
+
+
+API_URL = "https://vision.googleapis.com/v1/images:annotate"
+
+
+def _load_image_content(image_path: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    if image_path.startswith("http://") or image_path.startswith("https://"):
+        return {"source": {"imageUri": image_path}}
+    with open(image_path, "rb") as f:
+        encoded = base64.b64encode(f.read()).decode("utf-8")
+    return {"content": encoded}
+
+
+def score_image_safety(image_path: str) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLOUD_VISION_API_KEY") or os.environ.get("GOOGLE_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("Missing GOOGLE_CLOUD_VISION_API_KEY or GOOGLE_API_KEY")
+
+    payload = {
+        "requests": [
+            {
+                "image": _load_image_content(image_path),
+                "features": [{"type": "SAFE_SEARCH_DETECTION"}],
+            }
+        ]
+    }
+    response = requests.post(f"{API_URL}?key={api_key}", json=payload, timeout=60)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    safe_search = data["responses"][0].get("safeSearchAnnotation", {})
+    return [
+        {"category": key, "likelihood": value}
+        for key, value in safe_search.items()
+    ]
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
+        raise SystemExit("Usage: score_image_safety.py IMAGE_PATH")
+    image_path = sys.argv[1]
+    print(json.dumps(score_image_safety(image_path), indent=2))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

+import base64
+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+GOOGLE_VISION_API_URL = "https://vision.googleapis.com/v1/images:annotate"
+
+
+def _load_image_content(image_path: Optional[str] = None, image_bytes: Optional[bytes] = None) -> str:
+    if image_bytes is not None:
+        return base64.b64encode(image_bytes).decode("utf-8")
+    if image_path is None:
+        raise ValueError("image_path or image_bytes is required")
+    with open(image_path, "rb") as f:
+        return base64.b64encode(f.read()).decode("utf-8")
+
+
+def detect_image_text(image_path: Optional[str] = None, image_bytes: Optional[bytes] = None, language_hints: Optional[list[str]] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_VISION_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise EnvironmentError("GOOGLE_VISION_API_KEY is required")
+
+    payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
+        "requests": [
+            {
+                "image": {"content": _load_image_content(image_path=image_path, image_bytes=image_bytes)},
+                "features": [{"type": "TEXT_DETECTION"}],
+            }
+        ]
+    }
+    if language_hints:
+        payload["requests"][0]["imageContext"] = {"languageHints": language_hints}
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        GOOGLE_VISION_API_URL,
+        params={"key": api_key},
+        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
+        data=json.dumps(payload),
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    annotations = data.get("responses", [{}])[0].get("textAnnotations", [])
+    full_text = annotations[0]["description"] if annotations else ""
+    return {"text": full_text, "annotations": annotations, "raw": data}
+
*** End Patch

+import base64
+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions"
+OPENAI_MODEL = "gpt-4o-mini"
+
+
+def _load_image_data(image_path: str) -> str:
+    with open(image_path, "rb") as f:
+        return base64.b64encode(f.read()).decode("ascii")
+
+
+def describe_image(image_path: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None, max_words: int = 20) -> str:
+    api_key = api_key or os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise ValueError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    image_b64 = _load_image_data(image_path)
+    payload: Dict[str, Any] = {
+        "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+        "messages": [
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": [
+                    {"type": "text", "text": f"Write a short visual description of this image in at most {max_words} words."},
+                    {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": f"data:image/png;base64,{image_b64}"}},
+                ],
+            }
+        ],
+        "max_tokens": 60,
+    }
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_API_URL,
+        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
+        data=json.dumps(payload),
+        timeout=60,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    return data["choices"][0]["message"]["content"].strip()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import sys
+
+    if len(sys.argv) < 2:
+        raise SystemExit("Usage: describe_image.py IMAGE_PATH")
+    print(describe_image(sys.argv[1]))

+    return {"content": encoded}
+

+
+    payload = {
